claims.statement: The ingestion pipeline is shaped as collector -> durable append-only event log -> stream processor -> partitioned object storage, with the warehouse reading storage rather than the collector.

Admission control (authn, schema validation, receipt stamping) belongs to the stateless collector; deduplication, normalisation and batching belong to the stream processor; neither owns the other's concern.
Delivery is at-least-once with idempotent collapse on (tenant_id, event_id), because no transaction spans an HTTP client retry and commodity object storage.
Schemas are enforced at ingest from a versioned registry, and enforcement is made non-lossy by writing every rejected event to a dead-letter prefix.
design.md renders all three C4 levels with Mermaid flowchart plus subgraph and uses no C4Context or C4Container diagram type.
